paragraphs.text: Anger flashes in May’s eyes. “Would you strike a woman in her own house?” she snaps. “Eighteen people live on this street. If I scream, every one of them will come running.”
She scrambles from the guest room and into her bedroom. You consider pursuing the issue, but decide against it.
To secure your door with a chair and get some sleep, go to 58. To stay awake all night, go to 52.
